purpose: Mechanical privacy and hygiene scan; findings contain locations and classifications only, never matched contents or credentials.

compact_report.outcome: Patterns scanned; no claim of absence of all secrets or identification of live credentials. See findings and coverage.

scope_policy.protected_handling: Scanner only; no excerpts, keys, scenario content or evaluator answers used for authoring. Historical archive contents are scanned mechanically.
scope_policy.matching: Case-insensitive named organization patterns; local user/workspace paths and metadata fields, private/loopback IPv4, selected credential/token forms and quoted credential assignments; UTF-8 replacement decoding of every regular file and extracted archive member.

limitations: Pattern scan does not validate credential authenticity or exhaust all secret formats; entropy-only, encrypted, steganographic and non-UTF8 secrets can be missed.
Binary bytes receive UTF-8 pattern scan only; no OCR or PDF/Office semantic extraction; ZIP-based formats are unpacked if recognized.
Archive links not followed; encrypted/unsupported/oversized/depth-limited entries explicitly reported.
Organization matches can be historical or fictional; paths and metadata can be documentation/examples. Placeholder classifications are heuristic, not proof.
Concurrent nonprotected source/dist edits by other agents can make the inventory a point-in-time mixed snapshot; rerun after final rebuild.
Conservative protected handling covers all validation and historical input files, not only formal frozen sets.
No remote resources, git object history, excluded caches or filesystem outside this repository scanned.
